# Protection

> Time-boxed shields ("you can't be raided right now").

- Package: `Protection` · Category: Gameplay & world
- Starts at server boot: only when picked; otherwise the first time game code uses it
- Installing it also installs: [Data](Data.md)
- Check it is installed: `GaxiaServer.IsInstalled("Protection")` (server) / `Gaxia.IsInstalled("Protection")` (shared/client keys)

## `GaxiaServer.Protection`

- Runs: **server only (Script / server ModuleScript)**
- Source: `src/ServerStorage/Gaxia_Packages_Server/Lib/ProtectionService.lua`

Get it:

```lua
local GaxiaServer = require(game:GetService("ServerStorage").Gaxia_Packages_Server)
local Protection = GaxiaServer.Protection
```

### Functions

- `Protection.Grant(player: Player, duration: number): number`
- `Protection.IsProtected(player: Player): boolean`
- `Protection.GetRemaining(player: Player): number`
- `Protection.Clear(player: Player): ()`

### Signals

Connect with `:Connect(function(...) end)`; the parameters are the payload types, in order.

- `Protection.OnProtected` — `Signal<Player, number, number>`
  (player, untilTimestamp, duration) after Grant
- `Protection.OnExpired` — `Signal<Player>`
  (player) when Clear removes a shield that was still active (not on natural expiry)
